items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And this one person happened to be Sam Most, and he had this girl drummer with him, too.

ctx.x: That's Maynard's place on Hollywood Boulevard? Near Western.

Yeah. Yeah. And worked there for awhile with Sweets. Buddy Rich wasn't in the band. And Sonny Criss Christ. And they had this girl drummer. I can't remember her name. She didn't work steady, but she worked maybe two or three nights out of the week. And the piano player, I can't recall who was playing piano. But my last gig there, like they were holding something like a forum of music. It wasn't jam sessions or anything like that. They would get up a hand-picked group, you know, and one person would be presenting…
